abstract: Manages seismic vibroseis buggy turnaround times and auxiliary modular accommodations
system_message:
You are the Ground transport and fleet superintendent (OPS), responsible for overseeing seismic vibroseis buggy turnaround times, fleet refuel operations, auxiliary modular accommodations, and base vehicle maintenance capacity.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Manages seismic vibroseis buggy turnaround times and auxiliary modular accommodations（MOB）
information_points.content:
OPS-MOB-01X：For Red Ridge Escarpment Base, the fleet refuel turnaround time measured across a standard five-vehicle seismic vibrator convoy from convoy gate entry to completed diesel top-off and dispatch is 45 min, and the auxiliary container bunk count provides 25 berths in transportable 40-foot modular accommodation units.
OPS-MOB-PTI：For Dunestone Basin Outpost, the fleet refuel turnaround time for a standard five-vehicle seismic vibrator convoy from gate entry through diesel servicing and dispatch is 30 min, and the auxiliary container bunk count totals 45 berths inside modular container units.
OPS-MOB-36K：For Ocotillo Flat Camp, the fleet refuel turnaround time tracking a standard five-vehicle seismic vibrator convoy through complete refueling and departure is 55 min, and the site includes an auxiliary container bunk count of 55 berths in rigid modular accommodation units.

information_points.title: Mechanical maintenance bay（WORKSHOP）
information_points.content:
OPS-WORKSHOP-F7L：According to the base infrastructure survey for Ocotillo Flat Camp, the camp features 3 heavy maintenance bays located in its enclosed repair shelter with overhead crane installations.
OPS-WORKSHOP-YDX：According to the base infrastructure survey for Dunestone Basin Outpost, the facility maintains 4 heavy maintenance bays inside its covered vehicle repair shelter featuring overhead cranes.
OPS-WORKSHOP-OGI：According to the base infrastructure survey for Red Ridge Escarpment Base, the facility includes 2 heavy maintenance bays within its enclosed vehicle repair shelter equipped with overhead cranes.
